title: Release kit (lazycow.release-kit, version 1)
description: What an app's release kit holds for Lazycow Studio's product videos (docs/product-kit.md): screenshots before and after a release, short screen recordings, changelog lines and brand tokens. Any tool may export one (Mushi's export_release_kit is one). The TypeScript type is src/release-kit.ts; py/studio/product.py validate_manifest is the check the studio runs. Unknown fields are ignored; a different major version is refused.

version.description: The major version. A change that breaks readers gets a new number.

url.description: The app's site. Only its host is shown (in the browser frame).

stores.description: Where people get it: named on the end card.

colors.description: Text too close to the background (contrast under 4.5:1) is shown in white or near-black instead.

family.description: Used when it is one of the studio's bundled faces (docs/product-kit.md › Fonts) and no file is sent.

file.description: woff2, woff, ttf or otf, at most 8 MB.

logo.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP (no SVG), at most 5 MB; shown square with round corners.

cta.description: The end card's call to action. Default: Get <app name>.

labels.description: Words the video shows, for a kit in another language.

surface.description: The screen's name (Home, Search, Settings): shown above its caption; matches changelog lines and recordings.

before.description: The screen before the release (optional). PNG, JPEG or WebP.

after.description: The screen in this release. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 25 MB and 12000 px a side.

caption.description: Otherwise a changelog line for this surface, else the next unused one.

focus.description: Where the camera drifts to, as a share of the picture (0-1). Default x 0.5, y 0.35.

file.description: MP4, MOV or WebM, at most 250 MB, 120 s and 4096 px a side. Its sound is dropped.

trim.description: Seconds of the recording to use.

changelog.description: One change per line, in plain words. A line with a surface captions that screen; the rest caption screens in order, and up to four left over make a What's new card (not in App Store previews).

expiresAt.description: When the kit's signed links stop working.

source.description: Who made the kit (ignored by the studio).

device.description: Default: from the shape (tall = phone, wide and 960+ = desktop, else tablet).

platform.description: Picks the phone's camera cut-out (none for web).

url.description: https://… (absolute, or relative to the manifest's own link). A relative URL inherits nothing from the manifest link's query string, so a kit served from signed links must give each asset its own absolute signed URL. In a kit folder on the computer: a path inside that folder.

bytes.description: When given, the download must be exactly this size.

sha256.description: When given, the download must have this hash.

app.name: Quiet Notes
app.tagline: Notes that stay out of your way

changelog: Search finds notes in under a second
